run_create_rparis_dataset: run the script to download and create a Revisited Oxford Paris dataset in VISSL-compatible format
download_paris_dataset: download the Paris buildings dataset archives and metadata from the VGG and RevisitOp sources
create_revisited_oxford_paris_dataset: create a Revisited Oxford Paris dataset with database and query splits following the VTAB protocol
get_argument_parser: get an argument parser that accepts input path, output path, and download flag for the dataset creation script
cleanup_unused_files: cleanup downloaded archives and corrupted image files after dataset creation
